It's a small magnetic power bank that keeps your phone charged up, whether you have an iPhone or an Android. Since my daughter was going on vacation with her friends, I was really nervous about her phone dying while she was out in a strange city. I got her a 3-pack of them, and she said it's the best gift she ever got. Not only was she able to call an Uber at night and get back to her hotel safely, but she was able to take all the photos and videos she wanted without worrying about her phone dying. I was so relieved to get texts from her, and I'm glad she was able to have fun and stay safe with this little gadget. Grab your Snap N Charge and save up to $209 with a 5-pack today.

Credo che su questo aspetto l’azienda dovrebbe comunicare in modo più trasparente.

Inoltre, uno dei supporti ricevuti si è rivelato difettoso dopo la prima installazione e successiva rimozione. Ho contattato l’assistenza fornendo foto e video del problema.

Ed è qui che l’esperienza è cambiata completamente: il customer care si è dimostrato rapido, cortese e professionale. Dopo aver esaminato la documentazione inviata, il team ha riconosciuto il problema e ha disposto immediatamente la spedizione di un prodotto sostitutivo senza costi aggiuntivi.

Al momento in cui scrivo questa recensione non ho ancora ricevuto il ricambio, quindi questa valutazione si basa sulla fiducia e sulla qualità dell’assistenza ricevuta fino ad ora. Se il processo si concluderà come promesso, non avrò alcuna difficoltà a confermare pienamente questo giudizio.

Per questo motivo assegno 5 stelle al customer care e alla gestione del problema, pur auspicando una maggiore chiarezza sui tempi di spedizione.

The product took a month to get to me. That's a long wait for something so simple. It came from China.

I got magnetic chargers from Amazon. These came quickly, but the rest of the order was directly from Statik. The charge is so slow that my son's phone lost charge while on it.

I got the phone carmounts. The arm lost strength within 4 days and now falls. This is a problem with every carmount I've gotten (not just from Statik). If you can supply a way to retighten the arms, I would give the carmount a 5*. (Statik has stated it can be retightened through the base, but I have not seen such a thing. I have contacted them. I'll update if they respond.)

I got the Snap-n-Charge, magnetic power banks. I use Otters, and maybe only Otters aren't compatible, but the power banks are useless. That is a big fail, especially with no visible warning that it may not work with some cases. I do use the power bank, however, to charge my wireless mouse when I am too lazy to get up and plug it in. This doesn't elevate it far from being a useless charger. I would have to remove my case to use the power bank. A change to the design or an added attachment could fix this problem. I can plug in the magnetic end into the phone, but end is too deep into the case for the power bank to connect.

In summary: 

I see no hope for the magnetic chargers. They are just too slow. 1*

The power bank is unusable. 1*

The arm of the base loosened and can no longer support the phone. That is the only issue I've had with it (I got it in February). If they offer me an actual solution to the loose arm, it does deserve a 5*.

When I had a dilemma with my order, they gave me options to choose from, easy. Customer service was great. It didn't take long to get back to me.

I really did (note the tense) love the products, but sadly cannot say the same for the customer support.

A)  Products:  
The concept of a swivelling cable end with magnetic tips which detach is fabulous, I cannot fault it.  They look good, function well.  Most of them.  I have both the old ones and the new ones (and the tips/cables are not interchangeable, which is a shame but understandable) as I have been buying them for our family for years without issue.

The recently purchased GloBright Pro cable, however, is unusable.  I wouldn't mind it lighting up, even as brightly as it does, but the strobing?!  I have had to wrap mine to lessen the headache-inducing effect, but fear that the others have effectively binned theirs.

The Statik 360 Pro Adapter is another great concept, but sadly is not the same quality as our many earlier cables-  the pivot is extremely stiff, kind of defeating the object.

B)  The customer support:
Nice people.  Really they are.  However they are clearly overstretched and without adequate tools/training/whatever.  I have in the region of 30 emails between them and myself to resolve one issue from before Christmas and it took me until today to resolve it.  In total I have just archived 93 emails, but many of them will be the incessant "offers" for which I cannot blame the staff.

C)  My advice:
Use a credit card and make sure to screenshot every email where a promise is made and keep a record until after you received and tested your goods.  

Because, while they will happily send you a replacement, it all takes time.  Sometimes a lot of time without any information from the company (logistics are "farmed out" so that is a contributing factor).  At best-  they will give you a store credit which may or may not work, while the products change prices almost weekly and go on sale (and, as a result, out of stock) and off again quite quickly.  

In closing and for full disclosure:  the concept and, most of the time, also the quality is great.  We have washed tips by accident and they still worked after.  The cables look good and last.  OK, so a magnet once fell out of one of the tips, but it might have been hard-done by by one of the family.  However being a fair bit of money out of pocket and seeing how it is possible for refunds to disappear back out of one's bank account?  It can only pull the average down.
